content: स्वधा [स्वद्-आ-पृषो˚ दस्य धः] .²1 Oneʼs own nature or determination, spontaneity. .²2 Oneʼs own will or pleasure. .²3 The oblation of food offered to the Pitṛs or Manes of deceased ancestors; स्वधासंग्रहतत्पराः <ls>R. 1. 66</ls>; <ls>Ms. 9. 142</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 102</ls>. .²4 The food offered to the Manes personified. .²5 Food or oblation in general. .²6 Oneʼs own portion or share. .²7 A Śrāddha or funeral ceremony; <ls>Ms. 2. 142</ls>. .²8 <ab>N.</ab> of Māyā or illusion. --{%ind.%} An exclamation uttered on offering an oblation to the Manes (with <ab>dat.</ab>); पितृभ्यः स्वधा <ls>Sk.</ls>
